tracks.bollinger_taker: Each ticker on UTC 300-second grid: previous 20 fresh mid observations, population sd, buy one YES below mean-2sd or one NO above mean+2sd; exit at mean recovery or 3600 seconds, otherwise settlement. One entry per ticker per episode.
tracks.favorite_taker: First fresh UTC 300-second grid observation with a side ask 90 through 98 cents inclusive; one contract, one side per ticker, YES tie priority, hold to settlement. No outcomes used in selection.

execution: First same-ticker recorded snapshot at or after decision+1s and no more than 5s later; require valid uncrossed two-sided book and at least one displayed contract at executable level. Buy at ask, exit at bid; no passive or touch fills. Unexecuted exits remain owned and retry next decision; missing settlement remains unresolved.
fee: ceil(0.07*p*(1-p)*100) cents per one-contract taker fill, historical benchmark schedule; not proof of current market-specific fees
decision: Never qualifies live: four selected public episodes, external provenance and missing lifecycle/receipt-clock validation. Record every loss and exclusion; positive exploration requires separate larger unused validation and operational execution evidence.
restrictions: No orders, credentials, model calls, schedules or frozen production strategy edits. Read data only; independent replay code, do not execute downloaded repository code.
